`reference-tone.aiff`, `.flac`, and `.mp3` are generated test signals: one second
of a 1500 Hz sine at 48 kHz, with 0.1 peak amplitude before encoding. AIFF uses
24-bit PCM; MP3 uses libmp3lame at 192 kbps. No recorded or copyrighted music is
included. WAV and other DSP cases are generated by the tests.
